name: hero-slide
description: One slide of the hero carousel: full-bleed photo with headline, subline and an arrow link.

render.class: hero headline (brand type scale: fischer 36/46, fischertechnik 48/58, 600, white)

link.description: Renders the white arrow under the text; the arrow is the link.

image.description: 1920x648 (fischer) / 1920x720 (fischertechnik) landscape. Set the alt text in the asset's meta (translatable).

image_mobile.description: Optional portrait crop for small screens; falls back to the desktop image.

view.name: HeroSlide
view.notes: Rendered inside HeroCarousel's slide track. When the brand theme has brand_box=true (fischer) the text sits in a 400x534 var(--color-primary) box at top-left that starts under the 80px header (logo sits on it), padding 30px, headline 36px; text_align is ignored in that mode. Otherwise (fischertechnik) text sits directly on the image in a 444px column with 30px padding, left (or right when text_align=right), headline 48px white.
